Design guidance for idempotency keys and exactly-once semantics (Idempotency-Key header, Redis SET NX / PostgreSQL ON CONFLICT / DynamoDB conditional puts, outbox, sagas, testing) with Express/NestJS/FastAPI/Spring/GraphQL samples.

No commands the agent is told to run, no installs, credentials, or network access; output is a design as text unless the user asks for files (SKILL.md:32). SQL DELETE statements are cleanup jobs in the user's own schema.

Technical caveats a user should know: several samples fail open when the idempotency store errors (idempotency-middleware.md:57-59, idempotency-failure-modes.md:21-23), contradicting the fail-fast advice in idempotency-distributed.md:244, which can allow duplicate charges; keys are not scoped per client/tenant, so cached responses are shared by key; SKILL.md:166-183 caches transient 502 errors, which blocks legitimate retries; idempotency-storage.md:102-123 does select-then-insert (racy without the unique constraint) and :239-254 repeats ExpressionAttributeValues. SKILL.md:421-544 is a duplicated generic boilerplate block. Handoff names an optional 'distributed-locking' skill.
